title: App cache shared through Redis
prompt: The app will run on several servers that share a Redis. When the REDIS_URL environment variable is set, connect to it with the redis package (add REDIS_URL to the app's config as an optional secret) and keep the app cache (ctx.cache, app.cache and cached route responses) in Redis so every instance shares it. Without REDIS_URL, keep the default in-memory cache. Use Inferlo's built-in Redis cache store; do not write your own.
